sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret. “The One I Love.” label credit “Kaper; Jurmann; Kahn”. His Master's Voice, Katalog-Nr. B.8724, 1938. Digital transfer published on archive.org by Great 78 Project. Accessed 23 August 2026.
sources.title: The One I Love — His Master's Voice B.8724
sources.creator: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret
sources.researchNote: The discographic details were catalogued from the disc by The Great 78 Project; the transfer carries sound alone, so the label is not shown in the external recording. The item records the matrix number OA09934 and places the song in the film „Everybody Sing“; the disc is the British issue of the session Allan Jones made for Victor in January 1938, whose other side carries “Cosi Cosa”.

sources.title: Cosi Cosa — His Master's Voice B.8724
sources.creator: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret
sources.researchNote: The discographic details were catalogued from the disc by The Great 78 Project; the transfer carries sound alone, so the label is not shown in the external recording. The item records the matrix number OA09937 and places the song in the film „Everybody Sing“; the other side of the disc carries “The One I Love”. The American issue of the same session is Victor 4381, recorded on 13 January 1938.
